purpose: Independent verification of frozen CSV and raw SQLite; no signal regeneration or evaluate invocation.

unobserved_execution_edges.note: Primary CSV contains no actual limit-up skip or delayed-exit case. Source threshold and calendar logic inspected; these edges are not claimed as empirical sample coverage.

worst_trade_conclusion.conclusion: Large loss is present in raw local prices and matches model execution and fees; not a reference flag or marking error. A limit-down before planned exit does not defer the later eligible planned-exit close.

business_files_statement: This verification edited no business file, frontend, database or research script. Concurrent unrelated workspace edits may exist; no assertion that the entire workspace hash stayed unchanged.
limitations: Raw prices and historical identity/event completeness remain limited as stated in the data audit.
Model opening/closing executions do not prove actual queue fills.
Float32 storage introduces negligible sub-cent differences; independent SQLite return comparison tolerance is 0.0001 percentage point.
